{{Quote|Rima Farstar. Confirm that there is a Gamorrean piloting the second X-wing.|Pop-Dog E-wing pilot to Myri Antilles|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pop-Dogs]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], a unit within the [[Galactic Alliance Army|army]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]] and he intercepted [[Wraith Squadron]] members [[Myri Antilles]] and [[Voort saBinring]] while they were flying disguised [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] near Kuratooine's [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tildin]]. Claiming they had failed to identify themselves to the Pop-Dogs despite filing flight plans with [[Rimsaw Station]] and [[Kura City Flight Control]], he established a sensor lock on their starfighters and ordered them to identify themselves. After performing a visual inspection and questioning Antilles about her supposed wingmate, he accepted the pair's cover identities and cleared them to continue before departing with his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]].
<ref name="MK" />
